scripts.build:frontend: npm run prepare:frontend-assets && npx tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:frontend:v2 && npx tailwindcss -i web/styles/input.css -o public/output.css
scripts.build:frontend:v2: npx tsc -p tsconfig.v2.json && vite build --config vite.v2.config.ts
scripts.format:check: npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npx tsc -p tsconfig.v2.json
scripts.test:frontend:js-smoke: npm run build:frontend && FRONTEND_MODULES_DIR=public/js node --experimental-default-type=module --test test/frontend/frontend-api-contract.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-dashboard-contract.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-diagnostics.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-incidents.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-engineer-telemetry.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-ops-navigation.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-pipeline-workspace.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-history-stream.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-log-stream.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-overview-activity-stream.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-publisher-health-contract.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-status-stream.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-build-smoke.test.mjs test/frontend/frontend-dom-invariants.test.mjs
